thread:
asha: Quick RFC follow-up: preemptive capacity hints for smart routing. TL;DR proposal below, want quick sanity check before I open the PR.

samir: Can you paste the core DSL snippet here? easier to discuss.

asha: sure — core idea is a lightweight predicate + scoring override + a preempt_if condition. example:```policy "preemptive-hints" {
  match: tenant == "enterprise"
  score: weight(latency=0.6, cost=0.3, sla=0.1)
  preempt_if: backend.capacity_hint >= 0.15 && latency_p50 > 120ms
  hold_for: 60s  # cooldown/hysteresis
  fallback: { region: nearest, tier: best-cost }
}```

linh: we already surface capacity_hint from telemetry, but it's noisy for small backends. how do you propose smoothing?

asha: use EWMA over 30s with min_samples=50 and a floor of 0.02. rationale: quick reaction but avoid single-sample blips. pseudo: `capacity_hat = ewma(capacity_hint, alpha=0.2, min_samples=50)`

zoe: test concern: preemptive moves can cause oscillation (A->B->A). we need hysteresis + a cooldown window + prefer sticky affinity for active sessions.

samir: Agreed — hold_for 60s in policy + prefer affinity if session_tokens_present. also add tie-breaker that favors previous route if score delta < 5%.

mike: Operator story: we need reason codes and tracing tags for every preemptive decision. otherwise it's impossible to debug tenant complaints.

asha: yep. plan is to include `route_decision.reason` in traces: e.g. `reason=preemptive_capacity threshold=0.15 ewma=0.18`. Also log masked backend ids for privacy.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: preemptive-hints v1 -> 2% traffic on staging at 2026-03-19T14:03Z :white_check_mark:

zoe: Canary results: for affected tenants p99 latency down ~18% but cost up ~3%. error rate stable.

linh: rollback rules proposal: auto-rollback if cost_increase > 5% OR error_rate_delta > 0.5% (absolute). Also manual rollback flag.

samir: Edge case: when capacity_hint is missing (legacy backends), default to cost-only scoring so we don't prefer unknown backends for preempt. add `has_capacity_hint` predicate.

asha: API implications: expose `/policy/explain?tenant=...&input=...` that returns top-k scoring backends + reasons. This is needed for ops and partner-debugging.

zoe: security note: the explain endpoint must not leak internal hostnames. return stable salted ids or masked ids for external tenants. internal UI can show raw ids.

mike: I'll draft a short RFC doc (heuristics, signals, safe defaults, canary plan, rollback conditions, expose explain API). I'll own it.

asha: I'll open PR on policy-engine with: code, unit tests for EWMA/smoothing, integration test for hold_for + tie-breaker, and a small end-to-end canary harness.

samir: :thumbsup:

linh: can we also add synthetic traffic test to detect oscillation? small script that fuzzes backend capacity and asserts no >3 switches/min per tenant.

asha: good call — will add to the test plan.

zoe: ok let's sync tomorrow at 10am to review the RFC before ship.

mike: noted. I'll add the meeting and a short checklist for the rollout.

asha: thanks all — I'll post PR link when ready.
